embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: FILIGREE3D: Scaling Sparse Latent Flow Matching for Ultra-High-Resolution Image-to-3D Generation
fields.value: Alibaba Group — FILIGREE3D generates 3D geometry from a single image at very high voxel resolution (up to 4096^3, evaluated at 2048^3) using sparse latent flow matching with a technique the authors call "Structure-Aware Sparse Scaling." It reports large accuracy gains over Hunyuan3D 2.1 on the Toys4K benchmark.

fields.name: Does Native 3D Texture Generation Necessarily Require 3D Assets for Training?
fields.value: Tencent — The paper introduces Tex-Zero, a native 3D texture generation framework (VAE + diffusion transformer) trained entirely without 3D asset data.

fields.name: StoryEngine: A State-Grounded Agentic Framework for Video Storytelling
fields.value: Tencent (joint affiliation listed as "Tencent / National University of Singapore" for the author group; all three authors use @u.nus.edu emails) — StoryEngine is an agentic framework for long-form, multi-shot video storytelling that separates authoritative semantic story-state planning from fallible visual rendering to prevent error propagation across shots.

fields.name: ProDyGS: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from a Single Static Monocular Camera
fields.value: Sony — ProDyGS reconstructs dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes from video captured by a single static (non-moving) monocular camera, a setting where prior dynamic-view-synthesis methods fail due to a complete absence of multi-view geometric cues.

fields.name: Adaptive Latent Capacity for World Models
fields.value: Arm Research, Israel (flag) — The paper presents Adaptive LeWorldModel (ALeWM), a JEPA-based world model that learns to concentrate predictive information into compact prefixes of a wide latent space rather than using a fixed-width embedding.

fields.name: ReFM: Semantic-Aware Refinement Flow Model for Motion Retargeting
fields.value: Autodesk; Jingxiang Qu's work was conducted "during an internship at Autodesk" under their mentorship — ReFM addresses motion retargeting — transferring motion between characters with different skeletons — by treating it as progressive refinement rather than single-pass regression or direct copying of source motion.

fields.name: HapticWorld: an Interactive World Simulator with Real-time Torque Feedback
fields.value: NVIDIA — HapticWorld extends a learned interactive video-based world simulator with a lightweight torque-prediction head so that an operator collecting robot manipulation demonstrations gets real-time force/torque feedback during teleoperation, not just visuals.

fields.name: WanPE: Towards Cinematic Prompt Enhancement for Modern Text-to-Video Generation
fields.value: Alibaba Group — WanPE is a large (reported ~397B-parameter) prompt-enhancement model that plans cinematic elements — actions, camera trajectories, lighting, and sound — for text-to-video generation, rather than just elaborating captions descriptively.

fields.name: WALT: Learning World-Model-Aligned Latent Trajectories for Autonomous Driving
fields.value: Horizon Robotics; kept per the "comparable labs, flag" rule) (flag) — The paper proposes WALT (World-Model Alignment for Latent Trajectories), a method that builds a compact generative trajectory latent space by transferring knowledge from a frozen, pretrained driving world model (EponaV2) into a dual-branch trajectory autoencoder.

fields.name: TrackEverything: Long Horizon Dense Tracking via De-Duplicating 3D Scene Representations
fields.value: Meta — TrackEverything is a 3D point tracker that represents video as persistent 3D scene tracks in world coordinates so that tracking cost is decoupled from video length, letting it track all visible points across full videos rather than only sparse query points or short clips.

fields.name: OmniFabric: Coherent UV Space Texture Synthesis for 3D Garment Reconstruction
fields.value: Google — OmniFabric targets automated creation of production-ready 3D garment textures from a single reference image, a task where existing methods "bake environmental illumination and shadows directly into the texture map" or lose global coherence, making the result unsuitable for physical simulation or rel

fields.name: OREO: Fidelity Alignment in 3D Generation via On-the-fly Rendering-Editing Optimization
fields.value: Tencent — OREO targets the gap between generated 3D assets and real-world visual fidelity, noting that generated assets "often lack intricate textures and fine-grained details observed in real-world subjects" because 3D training data is far scarcer than 2D imagery.

fields.name: MVAgent: Multi-Agent Video Generation via Consistent Condition Construction and Shot-Level Policy Optimization
fields.value: Alibaba Group — MVAgent is a multi-agent pipeline for generating multi-shot videos that keep characters, spatial layout, and camera angles consistent across shots, built on top of a frozen video generator.

fields.name: From Scattered Gaussians to Structured Maps: Efficient Gaussian Splatting Coding via Dual-phase Morton Sorting
fields.value: Alibaba — The paper addresses the storage and bandwidth cost of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), whose unstructured millions-of-primitives representation resists standard video-codec compression.

fields.name: Unity Insight: A Production Code–Asset Index for LLM Coding Agents in Unity Projects
fields.value: Unity — The paper presents Unity Insight, a persistent, read-only code–asset index built to let LLM coding agents navigate Unity game-engine repositories, where gameplay logic spans C# scripts, prefabs, scenes, and ScriptableObjects linked by GUIDs and YAML serialization.
